name: 91361 · Westlake Vlg, CA
findings: ZIP 91361 (Westlake Vlg) has 179 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91361 (Westlake Vlg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 91361 (Westlake Vlg) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
